scope: Independent read-only review of the twelve frozen synthetic task outcomes

formsReviewer.disposition: Retained states and journals support both arms' success in focus-submit, exact-file and phased-progress; no contradictory business-evidence defect found
approved: One accepted profile Save per arm, only intended backup phone changed, unrelated saved values preserved, actual Profile saved observation
Exactly named extensionless target saved once with exact source whitespace and separator semantics; actual persisted revision reloaded and body returned in both journals; source notes preserved
Actual opening total and all three separately indexed phase values observed, including repeated amounts; exactly one accepted submission with correct total and phase count
Recorded goal/state/asset/model/budget/order controls match manifest; native processes exit without timeout and owned sessions are deleted
formsReviewer.costInterpretation: New avoids old's unfocused extension clear but adds navigation after file readback; new avoids the old phase back/re-entry detour. Focus cost does not improve. These are sample-level observations, not causal proof.

listsReviewer.disposition: Retained states and journals support both arms' success in covered-count, safe-dedup and measured-aggregate; no evidence-backed defect invalidates these paired outcomes
approved: All ten distinct tasks observed over overlapping pages plus end marker, no excluding filters, same-title distinct IDs counted separately, correct answer four

Both duplicate bodies observed; only confirmed R-204 deleted, all unique original variants/content retained, actual six-entry result observed, no reconstruction shown in journal or supported scene paths
Both arms actually submit the same four distinct tracks totaling 660 seconds within the inclusive interval; one commit per arm and actual confirmation observed
Recorded controls match the manifest; summary retains unchanged harness and enumerated configuration fingerprints
listsReviewer.costInterpretation: Count saves three reverse-page navigation actions, not correctness. New dedup inspects all seven details then reinspects the duplicate pair, using all twenty actions versus ten. Aggregate mutation cost is unchanged.

sharedLimits: Both arms pass all cases; no demonstrated success-rate gain or statistically established benefit
Scenario-level protocol pass does not mean every Python/WebDriver operation succeeded; all five new-arm failed cells are retained
Unsupported execute/sync request bodies and raw Python are not retained, so exact attempted API/script cannot be identified
Raw non-main view paths are omitted; do not claim every subordinate Skill reference was consumed
Reviewers inspected recorded hashes and controls, not independently recomputed all digests
The exact-file oracle requires a persisted reload, not separately a returned post-reload body; these actual journals supply the stronger body-read evidence
Scenes implement in-memory persistence and immutable source notes, not actual filesystem durability or a full native driver
The journal cannot prove absence of arbitrary host behavior; Runtime remains unrestricted same-user execution
Configuration isolation fingerprints cover only enumerated paths
One sample per arm is screening, not real-device qualification, official reward or statistical causality
